description:
As an authenticated tenant
  I want to create and rotate API keys
  So that I can manage credentials without losing access

elements.name: Create then rotate an API key issues a fresh secret

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for tenant "default-tenant"
I create an API key
the response status should be 201
the response should contain a "raw_key" field
I rotate that API key
the response status should be 200
the response should contain a "raw_key" field
the response rawKey should differ from the created key

elements.name: Rotating a non-existent key returns 404

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for tenant "default-tenant"
I send a POST request to "/api/v1/api-keys/does-not-exist/rotate" with that token
the response status should be 404

elements.name: A retried create with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original key, not a second one

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for tenant "default-tenant"
I create an API key with Idempotency-Key "bdd-retry-create-001"
the response status should be 201
I create an API key with Idempotency-Key "bdd-retry-create-001"
the response status should be 201
the response should be the same API key as the first attempt

elements.name: A create without an Idempotency-Key is rejected

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for tenant "default-tenant"
I send a POST request to "/api/v1/api-keys" with that token but no Idempotency-Key
the response status should be 400
the response should contain errorCode "idempotency_key_required"

elements.name: Creating an API key requires authentication

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for tenant "default-tenant"
I send a POST request to "/api/v1/api-keys" without any token
the response status should be 401

name: API Key lifecycle

I send a POST request to "/api/v1/invitations" with body:

I send a GET request to "/api/v1/invitations" with that token

I send a GET request to "/api/v1/invitations/public/nonexistent-token" without any token

elements.name: Creating an invitation requires authentication

steps.name: the application is running

I send a POST request to "/api/v1/invitations" without any token

description:
As the platform
  I want every Stripe event applied exactly once, and only when Stripe really sent it
  So that billing state never drifts from Stripe

elements.name: A signed event is applied once, and a redelivery is acknowledged without effect

steps.name: the application is running
Stripe event "evt_bdd_subscription_deleted" was never received
Stripe delivers a signed "customer.subscription.deleted" event "evt_bdd_subscription_deleted" for subscription "sub_bdd_active"
the response status should be 200
tenant "default-tenant" billing is on plan "Free" with status "canceled"
Stripe event "evt_bdd_subscription_deleted" is recorded as "processed"
Stripe delivers the same event again
the response status should be 200
Stripe event "evt_bdd_subscription_deleted" was applied exactly once

elements.name: An event with an invalid signature is rejected and not recorded

steps.name: the application is running
a Stripe event arrives with an invalid signature
the response status should be 400
Stripe event "evt_bdd_forged" is not recorded

name: Stripe webhooks

description:
As the platform
  I want to enforce tenant status restrictions on protected endpoints
  So that suspended or locked tenants cannot access resources

elements.name: Suspended tenant is blocked from billing endpoints

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for the current fixture tenant
I send a GET request to "/api/v1/billings/subscription" with that token
the response status should be 403
the response should contain errorCode "tenant_suspended"
the response error should contain a "message" field

elements.name: Locked tenant is blocked from billing endpoints

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for the current fixture tenant
I send a GET request to "/api/v1/billings/subscription" with that token
the response status should be 403
the response should contain errorCode "tenant_locked"

elements.name: Locked tenant error response has the correct shape

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for the current fixture tenant
I send a GET request to "/api/v1/billings/subscription" with that token
the response status should be 403
the response error should contain a "type" field
the response error should contain a "code" field
the response error should contain a "message" field
the response error should contain a "request_id" field
the response error should contain a "doc_url" field
the response should carry the header "X-Request-Id"
the error request_id should match the X-Request-Id header

elements.name: Active tenant passes the tenant status guard

steps.name: the application is running
I have a valid JWT for the current fixture tenant
I send a GET request to "/api/v1/billings/subscription" with that token
the response status is not 403

elements.name: Public endpoint bypasses tenant status guard entirely

steps.name: the application is running
I send a GET request to "/api/v1/billings/plans" without any token
the response status should be 200
